steps.en: Scaffold a game project (a Vite template)
steps.zh: 用脚手架建一个游戏项目（Vite 模板）
在 src/game.js 里启动游戏

steps.en: Creates the canvas, WebGL renderer and the game loop
steps.zh: 创建画布、WebGL 渲染器和游戏循环

steps.en: Compose a game object from small components
steps.zh: 用小组件拼出一个游戏对象

steps.en: Write behaviors as callbacks on keys, updates and collisions
steps.zh: 把行为写成按键、每帧、碰撞的回调

steps.en: Each frame it renders, steps physics and fires your callbacks
steps.zh: 每帧渲染、推进物理并触发你写的回调

value.en: No hand-written game loop, renderer or collision code — you write behaviors, KAPLAY runs the frame
value.zh: 不用手写游戏循环、渲染器和碰撞检测——你只写行为，KAPLAY 跑每一帧

sources: https://github.com/kaplayjs/kaplay README — Installation (npx create-kaplay my-game, edit src/game.js at localhost:5173) and Quick Overview (kaplay(), loadSprite, add([rect, pos, area, body, health]), onKeyDown("w", ...), onUpdate)
